properties.name: BFR46
properties.site-address: Oak View Stud Farm, Lombard Street, Horton Kirby
properties.notes: The site is located adjacent to Horton Kirby urban confines. The existing access onto Lombard Street could be utilised. Redevelopment of this site could contribute to improving the character of the area. Overall the previously developed part of the site is considered able to accommodate development however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
